title: Gender Lost In Translation: How Bridging The Gap Between Languages Affects Gender Bias in Zero-Shot Multilingual Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender preservation in multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT) by measuring the model's ability to produce correct feminine and masculine word forms. The methodology relies on comparing model outputs against correct and gender-reversed reference translations (gender-swapping) using BLEU and accuracy metrics, then calculating the gender gap between feminine and masculine accuracy scores.
